load_baseline_config: load baseline performance configuration from a JSON file path for diffusion test scenarios
build_diffusion_test_case: build a DiffusionTestCase with server args, sampling params, and validation flags for a single model test
create_diffusion_sampling_params: create DiffusionSamplingParams with prompt, image path, output size, and frame settings for image or video generation
create_diffusion_server_args: create DiffusionServerArgs with model path, GPU count, tensor parallel size, and LoRA adapter paths for a test server
build_performance_summary: build a PerformanceSummary from a RequestPerfRecord extracting end-to-end, denoise, and stage metrics
